post.description:
Encrypted file delivery via tokenized share URL. Returns the
public recipient URL + send id. Idempotency-Key header (24h cache) honored.

Auth: API key with share:send or send:create scope.

get.summary: Current API-key usage and rate-limit status
get.description:
Returns the calling API key's current-minute rate-limit
consumption: calls made, calls remaining, the per-minute limit, and when the
window resets.

Reads the live fixed-window rate-limit counter — the same one that sets the
X-RateLimit-* response headers on every API call. No database writes.

SELF-COUNTING: this request is itself counted against the key's quota, so
`calls_made` already includes this call. Use it for visibility, not tight polling.

Auth: API key (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer <riga_sk_*>) with the
`usage:read` scope. Session-JWT callers should use GET /api/account/usage for
org-level monthly usage instead.

200.description: Current-minute usage for the calling API key.

api_key_prefix.description: Non-secret display prefix of the key (never the full secret).

calls_made.description: Requests in the current window (includes this call). null if the counter is unavailable.

calls_remaining.description: max(0, rate_limit - calls_made). null if unavailable.

period_reset_at.description: When the current window resets (ISO 8601). null if unavailable.

rate_limit_status.description: 'ok' = live counter; 'unavailable' = rate-limit store unreachable (other fields still returned).

400.description: Called with a session JWT (no API key). Use GET /api/account/usage for org-level usage.

401.description: Missing/invalid/expired API key. Stripe-shape: { error: { type: "authentication_error", code }, request_id }.

403.description: API key lacks the usage:read scope. Stripe-shape: { error: { type: "permission_error", code: "missing_scope", param: "usage:read" }, request_id }.

post.description: Appends a type='ai.draft.proposal' record carrying the 7-field provenance envelope. Routes through append_ai_draft_proposal_record (D5/ADR 0012); the D7 trigger enforces agent_party_bindings. Scope: record.propose.

Appends an attestation.* / acknowledgement.* record VAL-rooted as a MUTATION block to its authorizing task ASSIGNMENT. Accuracy grounding (grounded_document_hashes) is substrate-enforced. Scope: record.propose.

get.description: Returns the record content, provenance envelope (when ai.*), supersession state, and chain_event_id. Records an atomic read_audit_log entry. Scope: record.read.

post.description: FGA: can_upload on the dataroom. Scope: task.propose.

get.description: Tasks assigned to the calling agent’s party set (user-symmetry). Omit dataroom_id for a cross-dataroom sweep. Keyset-paginated. Scope: task.read.

post.summary: Create a dataroom (integrator-provisioned, owner = key provisioner)
post.description: Provisions a dataroom OWNED by the human who minted the API key (api_keys.created_by, resolved server-side as AgentCaller.provisionerUserId). The owner is derived deterministically from the key — it is NOT read from the request body — so a programmatically-created room roots its chain (dataroom.created + governance.party_created genesis) to the accountable human. This is the integrator-as-org-owner principal (ADR 0043 §90), NOT an autonomous agent capability — dataroom creation is human-only on the agent FGA tree and is deliberately absent from the MCP surface. Scope: dataroom:create.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g. provisioner unresolvable / out of org).

get.summary: List datarooms the agent can view
get.description: Datarooms where the calling agent holds can_view (ADR 0045). Keyset-paginated. Scope: dataroom.read.

get.summary: Get a dataroom the agent can view
get.description: Core metadata (id, title, status, context, organization_id, timestamps) for a dataroom where the calling agent holds can_view (ADR 0045). Deliberately scoped to metadata — tasks, documents and Q&A are read via their own tools, not echoed here. 404 if not found or not viewable (existence does not leak). Scope: dataroom.read.
One JSON object per line, ASC by sequence_number (ADR 0016). FGA: can_verify_audit_chain (admin-grade). Pagination via the X-Next-Cursor / X-Count response headers. Scope: audit.read.

get.summary: Export the FULL workspace chain as verifier-input NDJSON (snapshot-consistent)
get.description: The whole ordered chain (seq #1→head) in the published chain-verifier input format — drop the file straight into @val-protocol/chain-verifier. Snapshot-pinned head on X-Chain-Head. Sync-streamed; very large chains return 202 + an async BullMQ→S3 download job. Scope: audit.read.

202.description: Chain too large for sync — async export job accepted.

get.summary: Poll an async full-chain export job
get.description: Status of an async (BullMQ→S3) chain export queued by GET …/audit/chain when the chain exceeds the sync ceiling; returns a signed S3 download URL when complete. FGA: can_verify_audit_chain. Scope: audit.read.

404.description: No such export job for this dataroom.

get.summary: List webhook deliveries for a chain event
get.description: Webhook deliveries triggered by one chain event (the dev-console Deliveries tab dogfoods this same route). FGA: can_verify_audit_chain. Scope: audit.read.

Verifier-compatible chain rows for a dataroom, keyset-paginated on sequence_number (O(page) on long chains). direction=desc (default) is newest-first. The dev-console records browser dogfoods this route. FGA: can_verify_audit_chain. Scope: audit.read.

get.summary: Get one chain event by its block hash
get.description: Resolve a block hash to its verifier-compatible chain row — the lineage primitive the record inspector uses to walk a MUTATION/ACCESS block to its ASSIGNMENT root (parent_assignment_hash). Read-only over existing rows. FGA: can_verify_audit_chain. Scope: audit.read.

404.description: Not found or not in this dataroom.

get.summary: Get one chain event by id
get.description: A single verifier-compatible chain row (the O(1) primitive the record inspector dogfoods). FGA: can_verify_audit_chain. Scope: audit.read.

404.description: Not found or not in this dataroom.

get.summary: VAL bytes-binding evidence bundle (ADR 0061) — owner/auditor only
get.description: Returns { document_bytes_base64, bytes_commitment_nonce, bytes_commitment, content_hash } — the disclosure the offline verifier Pass 6 consumes to prove the chain content-address binds to THIS document (bytesBinding: bound), with zero operator trust. Pair it with GET /v1/datarooms/:id/audit/chain. Owner/auditor-grade (FGA can_verify_audit_chain) — a cap_user agent/integrator key is refused. The opening nonce is disclosed only here, never on the chain. Scope: audit.read.

Returns decrypted bytes + content_hash. FGA: can_view on the document via its task-scoped folder grant. Records a non-repudiable read_audit_log entry — the grounding source for record.attest. Scope: document.read.

post.description: Creates a folder in the dataroom. Integrator-as-org-owner principal: authorized as the human who minted the key (can_edit on the room), NOT as an autonomous agent. Deliberately absent from the MCP surface. Scope: dataroom:create.

403.description: Provisioner lacks can_edit on the dataroom.

get.summary: List folders the agent can view
get.description: Folders in the dataroom where the calling agent holds can_view (ADR 0045), with the same visibility filtering + breadcrumb redaction a human gets. Scope: dataroom.read.

get.summary: List documents the agent can view
get.description: Documents in the dataroom where the calling agent holds can_view (ADR 0045), optionally filtered by folder_id. Same FGA visibility a human gets. Scope: dataroom.read.

post.description: Returns a presigned S3 PUT URL for direct upload + a fileId. Then PUT the bytes to the URL and call POST …/documents/confirm with the fileId. Integrator-principal: the file is recorded against the human who minted the key (uploaded_by). The SDK collapses presign→PUT→confirm into client.documents.upload(file). Scope: dataroom:upload.

403.description: Provisioner lacks can_edit on the dataroom.

post.description: Confirms the file landed in S3 and triggers async processing (encrypt with the per-dataroom DEK, dedup, emit document.uploaded). Returns { status: 'processing', fileId } — the chain event commits asynchronously (poll the document, or a webhook signals completion). Must be called by the same key that presigned. Scope: dataroom:upload.
Records the answer as a VAL MUTATION block rooted to the thread ASSIGNMENT. A doc-scoped thread becomes qa.answer.grounded (grounded_document_hashes REQUIRED). Scope: qa.propose.

info.title: RIGA API
info.description: RIGA Layer-2 substrate — verifiable authorization lineage. REST is the canonical surface; the SDK and MCP server are adapters over it (ADR 0051).

authored_by_party.description: The agent party authoring the record. Optional — defaults to the authenticated agent (resolved server-side).

method_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical method.

authored_by_party.description: Optional — defaults to the authenticated agent (resolved server-side).

service_id.description: Optional service ID to link the dataroom to a service

template_config.description: Optional template configuration for auto-creating folders and tasks

templateId.description: Optional template ID to apply folder structure from

context.description: Dataroom context for persona-based invitation flow

owner_user_id.description: UUID of the human user who will own this dataroom. Required when creating via API key (service account). Ignored when creating as a human user (the caller is the owner).

status.description: pending = vault key creation in progress/failed; active = ready for use

archived_at.description: When the dataroom was archived (read-only mode)

context.description: Dataroom context for persona-based invitation flow

governance.description: Governance template settings for this dataroom

parent.description: Unified parent reference (engagement, booking, async_job, or brief)

active_size.description: Total size of active documents in bytes

archived_size.description: Total size of archived documents in bytes

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID for nested folders

fulfillsTaskId.description: Task ID this document fulfills (for document request tasks)

presignedUrl.description: Presigned S3 PUT URL for direct upload

fileId.description: Document ID created in the database

stagingKey.description: S3 key where the file will be uploaded

quotaWarning.description: Quota warning if storage limit exceeded (soft enforcement)

fileId.description: Document ID returned from presign endpoint

grounded_document_hashes.description: 64-hex content_hash of source documents. REQUIRED for a doc-scoped thread (qa.answer.grounded); each must match a live document the agent has read.
